purpose: views-only-item: HEAD c492d77 (built twice, A/A) against 267a518 and c47fde2; the bench source of HEAD over the include/ of each commit; openSUSE Tumbleweed, bench/runtime.cpp
rule: an old arm differs from HEAD when it lies outside both HEAD binaries (built twice) and the gap to the nearer one is above the A/A of the cell
steal_rule: a round whose steal is above 0.1 percent of the CPU time is excluded from every median
order: each round runs every cell of every binary once, as its own process, in an order from shuf
binaries: one binary per arm and compiler; it holds every operation and document of the arm as one cell each (the bench source with main renamed to a cell function and return 0 added; a driver main picks the cell by its first argument)
build_source: the bench sources of HEAD over the include/ of each commit; an operation is absent where it does not compile at that commit
